description:
Get full sourced facts for one slug: an AI build tool, an agent harness or an Agent Toolbox entry.

Use when: you need pricing, licence, features or app stats for a single tool. For several at once use compare_tools.

Behavior: Read-only. Returns official pricing with checked date and source, app stats and Vibe Shipped links, or isError (not_found) for an unknown slug.

Example: {"slug":"lovable"}

slug.description: Tool, harness or Agent Toolbox slug, e.g. cursor, claude-code, cline.

name: get_tool
title: Get one AI build tool or agent tool
